content.short: Valos is a specialist investment manager offering institutional-quality strategies in digital assets.
content.description: Valos manages institutional investment strategies delivered on-chain, operating on Monad. Its positioning sits with the group of managers treating public chains as a settlement and distribution layer for conventional investment products, rather than as a separate asset class requiring separate strategies.
